title: Sharib Hashmi Recalls Losing Out On Sanju, Bajrangi Bhaijaan Despite Being Shortlisted: 'Naseeb Ki Baat Hai' | Bollywood News - News18
text: Sharib Hashmi, popular for his role as JK in The Family Man, has proved his mettle as an actor. He has been part of several big films and series, including Jab Tak Hai Jaan, Vikram Vedha, and Scam 1992. Recently, Hashmi spoke about missing out on two big films and expressed his disappointment. He revealed that he had auditioned for Kamli’s role in Sanju, the biopic on Sanjay Dutt directed by Rajkumar Hirani. But the part was eventually played by Vicky Kaushal, and it became one of his most loved performances. Sharib Hashmi talks about losing Sanju and Bajrangi Bhaijaan While speaking to Filmygyan, Sharib was asked about the missed opportunities in his career. He went on to reveal about facing rejections for Ranbir Kapoor’s Sanju and Salman Khan’s Bajrangi Bhaijaan. He shared that he had auditioned for Nawazuddin Siddiqui’s role in the Kabir Khan film. Despite getting shortlisted for both films, he didn’t bag the role. Sharib said, “Mujhe Sanju ka ek bada afsos hai, jo role kiya tha Kamli ka, uske liye mein kaafi shortlist hua tha, kaafi time tak chal raha tha. To vo ek afsos hai. Fir Bajrangi Bhaijaan me jo Nawazuddin Siddiqui ne kiya tha, uske liye bhi mene audition diya tha aur shortlist hua tha, kuch rounds of audition hue the mere, but vo naseeb ki baat hai. (One big regret I have is Sanju. For the role of Kamli, I was shortlisted, and the process lasted quite some time. So that remains a regret. Then, for Bajrangi Bhaijaan, the role that Nawazuddin Siddiqui played, I had auditioned for that as well and was shortlisted. I went through a few rounds of auditions, but that’s a matter of destiny)." Bajrangi Bhaijaan was released in 2015, and it was a box office hit. The film resonated well with the audience, and it marked Salman’s best performance. In the film, Nawazuddin played the role of Chand Nawab, a Pakistani TV journalist who helps Bajrangi in reuniting a mute Pakistani girl with her family. On the other hand, Sanju hit theatres in 2018. The Rajkumar Hirani directorial starred Ranbir Kapoor as Sanjay Dutt, and the audience was mesmerised by the uncanny resemblance. Vicky played the role of Kamli, his best friend. This film was also a box office hit. Meanwhile, Sharib was recently seen in Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos, a spy comedy produced by Aamir Khan and directed by Vir Das.
summary: Sharib Hashmi, popular for his role as JK in The Family Man, has proved his mettle as an actor. He has been part of several big films and series, including Jab Tak Hai Jaan, Vikram Vedha, and Scam 1992. He revealed that he had auditioned for Kamli’s role in Sanju, the biopic on Sanjay Dutt directed by Rajkumar Hirani. The Rajkumar Hirani directorial starred Ranbir Kapoor as Sanjay Dutt, and the audience was mesmerised by the uncanny resemblance. Meanwhile, Sharib was recently seen in Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos, a spy comedy produced by Aamir Khan and directed by Vir Das.
